raw_signal: הוא אמר לי גם אין פה כלום וגם צדקת, בשתי שורות אחת מתחת לשנייה. אני לא יודע איזה מהם התוצאה.
observations: First reveal, agreement case. Block 'מה קרה כאן': 'אין כאן דבר שהמדידה תומכת באמירתו. בחרת בתוך רעש ההערכה, והביטחון שלך לא היה נמוך ממנו. זו תוצאה תקינה, לא מסך ריק.'
Block 'מה שווה לבדוק', 60px below it: 'בחרת את b5b4, וזה גם המהלך של המנוע.'
Both are true and both are the intended vocabulary: the first is the finding, the second is the fact the finding rests on.
Second reveal, disagreement case, is shaped differently: 'd5d4 עלה 436 ס״פ מול d7e5' with 'מבוסס על: 436 ס״פ בעומק 14'.
The second reveal also carries 'המשפט הזה יצא מהשוואה למנוע בלבד — לזה גם ניתוח משחק רגיל היה מגיע.'
Eight lines below that, the one-time question reads 'מה קיבלת כאן שלא היית מקבל מניתוח רגיל של המשחק?'

candidate_mechanisms.name: The evidence vocabulary is doing exactly its job and the ordering is what a first reader cannot hold
candidate_mechanisms.explains: Why both sentences are correct and why they still read as opposed.
candidate_mechanisms.does_not_explain: Whether a person actually reads them as opposed, which no amount of reading the screen can settle.
candidate_mechanisms.discriminator: A person, shown one reveal, restating unprompted what it claimed and what it did not.

candidate_mechanisms.name: The commodity disclaimer sits close enough to the O-3 question to prime its answer downward
candidate_mechanisms.explains: Why an answer of 'nothing' would be cheap to produce on that screen.
candidate_mechanisms.does_not_explain: Whether the answer would differ if the two were separated.
candidate_mechanisms.discriminator: Ask the O-3 question on a session whose reveal carried no disclaimer, and compare. The disclaimer is conditional, so both arms already exist.

design_distinction: A reveal can be correct and unreadable at the same time. Nothing on the screen tells them apart, and no amount of my reading it does either.
rejected_explanations: A copy bug: neither sentence is wrong, and the pair is the intended evidence discipline.
That I could judge this myself: I am not a first reader of this product, and my own reading is not evidence about anyone else's.
must_not_change: The four-block order and the evidence labels. They are frozen and this finding is not authority to move them.
perceptual_success_criterion: A person restates, unprompted, both what the reveal claimed and what it said it could not claim.
next_step: This is F-2 and it stops here. What can be done before a person is present: record which reveal shape preceded each O-3 answer, so the answers are not pooled across a screen that carried a commodity disclaimer and one that did not.
